Jantar Mantar Delhi

A 90-minute heritage walk in Connaught Place, Delhi

On request

Arranged for your group. Send your preferred dates, group size and location. We adapt the length, level and language, and prepare a quotation. The suggested group size is a guide, not a requirement.

Request on WhatsApp Request by email

No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

On this walk you decode historic instruments and eighteenth-century observational practice.

The date, start time, pace and language are arranged to suit your group.

What it covers

  • Entrance and orientation
  • Samrat Yantra viewpoint
  • Misra and other yantra views
  • Workshop recap

How the time is spent

  1. Entrance and orientation 15 min

    Situate Jai Singh II and 18th-century astronomical work.

    You: concept map

  2. Samrat Yantra viewpoint 30 min

    Explain shadow/time concept without unsupported precision.

    You: paper exercise

  3. Misra and other yantra views 30 min

    Compare types of measurements.

    You: instrument diagram

  4. Workshop recap 15 min

    Differentiate observation, calculation, restoration.

    You: simple exercise

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Identify and interpret key features of Jantar Mantar Delhi using material evidence and a site map.
  • Decode historic instruments and eighteenth-century observational practice.
  • Distinguish directly visible fabric from reconstructed or debated historical claims.

You take away

Your annotated field card, sketches and notes.

Where
